name: Helikoprion
description: Helikoprion was a waterworld in the Helikoprion system in the Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Heliko species. After the planet was engulfed in a civil war, the Delik family, who resided on Helikoprion, moved off-world.
